caption: Sunlight passes through a glass of red wine on a white tablecloth, and a red patch of light appears on the cloth beside the glass.

sa.check: A glass of red wine stands on a tablecloth.
A red patch of light appears on the cloth beside the glass.

pc.expect: The red patch lies on the side away from the sun and would disappear if the glass were lifted.
pc.fail: It lies on the sun side; or is there with no glass; or the glass is in sun with no patch.

pc.expect: The patch is the wine's red.
pc.fail: It is white; or a different colour; or it changes colour with the glass still.

pc.expect: The patch moves only when the glass moves.
pc.fail: It drifts with the glass still; or stays put while the glass moves; or flickers in steady sun.

pc.expect: The patch is one soft shape roughly the glass's footprint.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or floods the cloth.
A second glass appears; or the patch becomes solid; or the glass vanishes.

pc.expect: The cloth and the glass stay the same.
pc.fail: The cloth changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the table setting rearranges.
